name: Caltrops 1
description: Scatter caltrops on your tiles and tiles directly beside you for 10s.  Each trap deals minor damage, ignoring armor and flows the first 4 enemies for 4s.  The trap under you only works once you step off.

name: Frost AArrow 1
description: Fire an arrow of frost at a target, applying Suain to all monsters within 4 tiles.

name: Marksman's Focus 1
description: For 10s, Steady Aim gains 1.5x damage bonus.  Pure only.

name: Point Blank 1
description: For 6s any monster that strikes you from directly beside you will take a point blank arrow and thrown 2 tiles back.  Bosses will not be moved.

name: Shadowmeld 1
description: Shroud yourself for 5s, wiping all aggro and cleansing negative effects (Suain, Beag Suain, pramh, root, etc).  Can be cast even while under those effects.

name: Smoke Arrow 1
description: Launch an arrow applying Dall (blind) to all enemies within 4 tiles of where it lands.

name: Snare Ring 1
description: Places 4 snares around your target.  Each deals heavy damage to the first enemy to touch them, and roots them for 3s.

name: Venom Arrow 1
description: An arrow that applies Venom to all enemies within 3 tiles of where it lands.

name: Volley 1
description: Launch a volley of arrows striking every enemy within 2 tiles.  Does damage over time based on how long the enemies remain in it.

name: Deadfall Array 1
description: Lays 5 pitfall traps (1 on you, and 1 in each direction beside you).  Each deals massive pure damage to the first target to step on it.   Damage scales with the enemy's health up to a limit.

name: Death Mark 1
description: Names an enemy for death for 10s.  All damage against target increases by 10%.  Costs 20 malice and returns 15 if the target dies while marked.

name: Shadow Step 1
description: Step through the dark to any creative within 5 tiles, landing at their back.  If there's no free location, it will not cast.  Costs 20 malice and works on both enemies and allies.

name: Shadowlurk 1
description: Shrouds you in darkness for 5s.  Clears all threat and negative effects.

name: Ard Ioc Comlha
description: Restores health to your group within 12 tiles, but not yourself.  Scales with WIS.

name: Blessed Intervention 1
description: Blesses you and your group within 12 tiles for 15s.  Next 5 hits each member takes will heal them.  Scales with WIS and max mana.  Damage over time does not count as a hit.

name: Dirge of Sorrow 1
description: Weakens enemies within 6 tiles, lowering their damage by 8% up to 12% at full harmony.  Slows the walk speed of monsters by 1/5 or more (including bosses).  Drains 250 mana + 1% of max each second.  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).

name: Fortissimo 1
description: Strikes every enemy on the 8 tiles around you.  With with INT and max mana.

name: Hymn of Judgment 1
description: Strikes chosen tile and four tiles beside it with intense light.  Scales with INT and max mana.

name: Mesmerize 1
description: Melody that lulls the enemy to sleep for 14s.  The first hit that lands deals far more damage and wakes it.  Bosses are immune.

name: Song of Mending 1
description: A song that heals you and you group within 6 tiles for 3*WIS + 1% of their max health each second.  Anyone at full health gains a barrier instead (pets not affected).  Drains 250 mana + 1% of your max mana each second.  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).

name: Song of the Bulwark 1
description: Restores 1% of the group's max mana each second, within 6 tiles.  Every 3s, removes one affliction from each member (suain, dall, cradh, miasma, poison, burn, amnesia or slow).  Drains 250 mana each second.  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).

name: Song of the March 1
description: Raises the Skill and Spell damage of your group within 6 tiles by 8%, and up to 12% at full harmony (assails and pets not affected).  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).

name: Adrenaline 1
description: Surge of adrenaline that lasts 20s.  A fatal hit will leave you at 1 health, followed by a 25% heal of your maximum health and enter adrenal flow.  2 minute cooldown.

name: Reckless 1
description:
For 45s you deal 5% more damage, plus another 2% for every rank of Rage.  Your AC increases by 8, plus another 2 per Rage rank and all healing is decreased by 35%.

Healing past your full health becomes Bloodlust. Half of the overflow turns into 100 bonus skill damage per second, up to 1000.  It lasts 15s, then builds again from nothing.  Life steal does not apply.

name: Ancient Grove 1
description: Roots a grove on a tile for 45s.  Your group within 5 tiles take 12% less damage and heal 1.5% of their hp each second.  While standing in your own grove, take 3% less damage every 8s, up to 15%.  Leaving your grove resets the roots, and planting a new one uproots the last.  Pure only.

name: Ashen Pull 1
description: Drag enemies from the tile you target, and 4 tiles around it to your side.  Taunts enemies, and reapplies every second for 5s.

name: Barkskin
description: Bark enhances your skin for 45s (lowers AC and raises MR) for every enemy within 2 tiles.  Ignores 8% of all damage, and gives 35% chance to reflect damage back.  Standing in a grove doubles these.

name: Briarcoat 1
description: For 12 seconds everything that strikes you takes 20%  of damage returned (Takes into account enemies full damage without reductions).  Can't damage more than 25% of your max health.

name: Cleansing Rain 1
description: Rains cleansing energy in a 3x3 area removing afflictions.

name: Defiance of Heaven
description: Wards your group (excluding yourself/pets) within 12 tiles for 30s.  Prevents fatal blows, instead leaves aislings at 1 health, with 3 seconds of invulnerability.  Can only cast with someone in range.

name: Heart of the Grove 1
description: Forces the grove you are standing in to fully mature for 10s.  All enhancements it provides are doubled for everyone inside.  Gains max root effects instantly.  Must be your own grove.  Pure only.

name: Seething Hatred 1
description: Taunts an enemy for 5s.  Every second, starting 1s after cast, adds 2500 threat for each point of CON.  Casting it again refreshes.

name: Serene Touch 1
description: Restores 1200 health + 18*WIS + 6% of max mana to your group within 2 tiles.  Extra healing costs no mana.

name: Thornbound 1
description: Binds every ally within 8 tiles to you for 20s.  You take 20% of all damage dealt in their place, until you've taken 75% of your own max health on their behalf.  Allies who leave 8 tiles are released, and those who return are bound.  You can die from shared damage.

name: Verdant Grove 1
description: Roots a grove on a tile for 45s. Your group within 5 tiles take 12% less damage and heal 1.5% of their hp each second. While standing in your own grove, take 3% less damage every 8s, up to 15%. Leaving your grove resets the roots, and planting a new one uproots the last.

name: Blink
description: Teleports you up to 7 tiles away so long as no wall blocks the path.

name: Bubble Shield 1
description: Surrounds you with bubbles for 12s blocking enemies.  Pets and group can move through them.  Bubbles will break after 5 hits from an aisling, or 10 from a monster.

name: Call Lightning 1
description: After 2s delay, strike chosen location 5 times.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply crit.

name: Cloudburst 1
description: Every splashed enemy within 10 tiles swells into a greater splash, spreading its damage to enemies within 2 tiles instead of 1.  Their remaining duration is preserved.  Cannot be cast with nothing splashed.

name: Cyclone 1
description: Summons a wind tornado for 8s.  Every 0.5s it pushes enemies on or beside it 1 tile away.  Bosses are not moved and aislings can pass through.

name: Earth Barrier 1
description: Raise a barrier of earth that absorbs damage equal to 50% of your max mana.  Casting again will stack more barriers, up to a cap of 50% of your max health.  After 20s without taking damage it loses 10% of what is left each second.

name: Ember Ward 1
description: For 20s your spells have +25% spell damage and +300 flat spell damage on every spell hit.

name: Fire Wall 1
description: Creates a 2x5 wall of fire in front of you for 8s.  Every 0.5s enemies standing in it take 4% of their max health (less against bosses), with a 20% chance to burn.  Sal spells cast can extinguish.

name: Galeform 1
description: For 20s you gain -20 AC, +25 MR and 15% faster assails.

name: Groo 1
description: Strikes a chosen area that cascades outward 2 tiles.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 25% chance to apply Beag Suain.

name: Ignis 1
description: Strike a chosen area that cascades outwards 2 tiles.  Damage scales with your mana and has a 25% chance to apply burn.

name: Keeter 1
description: Strike a chosen area that cascades outward 2 spaces.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 25% chance to apply crit.

name: Meteor 1
description: Call down a meteor on target, cascading outward 2 tiles and leaving fire behind.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply burn.

name: Mud Wall 1
description: Surrounds a target with walls of mud for 12s.  You and your group may pass through.  Each wall breaks after 5 hits from an aisling, or 10 from a monster.

name: Nera 1
description: Strikes a chosen area that cascades outward 2 more tiles.  Damage scales with your mana and has a 25% chance to apply splash.

name: Proliferation 1
description: Every burning enemy within 10 tiles spreads its fire to the foe beside it.  It's own burn is refreshed to full duration.  Cannot be cast with nothing burning.

name: Seismic Shift 1
description: Spell cascades outward in a cone up to 3 tiles, striking enemies and pushing them away.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply Beag Suain.

name: Static Field 1
description: Surrounds a friendly target for 10s.  Every 0.5s enemies on all sides are marked with crit, and next spell/skill deals 30% more damage.  The field itself deals no damage.

name: Subsuming Sands 1
description: Tears open a rift of sand for 8s.  Every 1.2s it deals 200 + 8*INT to enemies within 2 tiles and drags them towards the center.  Anything caught in the eye takes double damage.  Bosses are hit, but not pulled.

name: Tidal Wave 1
description: Sends a wave of water cascading outward in a cone up to 5 tiles.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply splash.

name: Tidewell 1
description: Opens a well beneath your magic, returning 10% of your max mana every 2s for 20s.

description: A disease that confuses the enemy for 12.  Each hit they deal has a 25% chance to strike themselves instead (including spells).  Drains 0.25% of their max health per second, and during it's first 7s will spread the disease to those directly beside them.  Never takes an ally below 1 health. Pure Only.

name: Gangrene 1
description: Rot that slows the enemy's attack by 30% for 30s.  In it's first 7s it spreads to those directly beside them.  It drains only when they move or land a hit and the drain is based on your INT and spell damage.

name: Inoculation 1
description: Wards you or an ally for 60s, absorbing the next disease or the next harmful effect.  Gain 15 ichor when it triggers.

name: Lance the Bubo 1

name: Leech Jar 1

name: Pestilence 1
description: Drains the enemy for 0.8% of it's max health each second for 30s (less against bosses), and feeds your ichor.  In it's first 7s, it spreads to those directly beside them.  Allies can catch it.

name: Plague Cloud 1
description: A cloud of rot that clings to your target, and follows them for 15s, infecting anything standing within 3 tiles.  The rot lasts 15s, drains health each second and eats their armour (worsening from 5 AC to 15).  It also cuts healing received by 30%.  If the target dies (or leaves), the cloud will settle where it last stood.  If the target dies it will burst onto nearby enemies

name: Quarantine 1
description: Seals off a 5 tile zone where you stand for 20s.  Disease cannot spread across the edge in any direction, though death bursts and plague clouds still reach over it.  Diseases inside will hit 25% harder and pays 50% more ichor.  Ends if you die.

name: Triage 1
description: Stripes every PD disease, including poison, miasma, burn, amnesia and slow from you and your group within 12 tiles.  Costs 10 ichor, plus 5 for each effect it removes.

The rot lasts 15s, drains health each second and eats their armour (worsening from 5 AC to 15).  It also cuts healing received by 30%.  If the target dies (or leaves), the cloud will settle where it last stood.  If the target dies it will burst onto nearby enemies.
